metaDescription: Send EN 16931 e-invoices over Peppol from your iPhone. Free unlimited invoicing with a real VAT engine, plus Factur-X compliance when you need it. Try it free.
heroHeadline: Invoices your tax authority can actually read
heroSubhead: The EU is making electronic invoicing mandatory. A pretty PDF is no longer enough. Pay Day creates EN 16931 e-invoices and delivers them over Peppol, straight from your iPhone.
highlights: Peppol delivery into your client's system
Works fully offline, no account to start

features.title: Real VAT Engine
features.body: An EN 16931 VAT engine handles standard rates, intra-community reverse charge, zero-rated and exempt lines, with a correctly rounded breakdown on every document.

features.title: Factur-X E-Invoices
features.body: One hybrid file looks like a clean invoice to your client and carries embedded EN 16931 data a tax system reads automatically. Validated as a PDF/A-3 with valid XML.

features.title: Peppol Delivery
features.body: Send invoices straight into your client's accounting software over the EU's official network. No email attachment, no portal login.

features.title: Live VAT Validation
features.body: Check every client's VAT ID against the EU VIES service before you issue. Validation is advisory, so it never blocks a send.

features.title: Recurring & Branded
features.body: Set a recurring invoice once and get paid every month. Add your logo, accent colour, and templates that match your business.

features.title: AI Helpers, Optional
features.body: Snap a receipt into line items, draft an invoice from a description, or write a payment reminder. A few credits each, never required.

howItWorks.body: Add a client, drop in line items, and Pay Day computes the VAT breakdown and totals as you go.
Export a branded PDF for free, or generate a compliant Factur-X e-invoice with embedded EN 16931 data.
Email the PDF, or deliver it over Peppol directly into your client's accounting system.

faq.a: Yes. The free tier gives you unlimited invoices and estimates, unlimited clients, your logo, multi-currency, and the full VAT engine, with no watermark and no per-document limit. It is a complete invoicing tool, not a trial.

faq.q: What does Pay Day Pro cost?
faq.a: Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual; the annual plan includes a 7-day free trial. It unlocks Factur-X e-invoices, Peppol delivery, recurring invoices, branding, and VAT validation. You can cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Credit packs are one-time purchases that cover each Peppol network send at its real per-send cost, instead of padding the subscription. The same credits power optional AI helpers. Local PDF export never needs credits.
Yes. You can build and export invoices fully offline from a job site, a train, or anywhere. Only Peppol sends, VAT validation, and AI actions need a connection.

faq.q: Where is my business and client data stored?
faq.a: On your device. Your business and client data stays on the phone; the server only ever sees what you explicitly send, such as a VAT ID to validate or an invoice to transmit over Peppol.

faq.q: What is EN 16931 and why does it matter?
faq.a: EN 16931 is the EU's structured e-invoice standard. Mandates are rolling out across the EU, starting with Belgium in 2026, so a normal PDF will no longer satisfy many tax authorities. Pay Day produces compliant Factur-X and Peppol BIS 3.0 invoices built to that standard.

faq.q: Which platforms does Pay Day support?
faq.a: Pay Day runs on iPhone. No desktop software and no separate bookkeeping suite required.

faq.q: How do I cancel or get a refund?
faq.a: Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID settings; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Refunds are handled by Apple through your purchase history.

ctaLine: Be ready for the EU e-invoicing mandates. Start invoicing free today.
pricingNote: Free unlimited invoicing; Pro is a monthly or annual subscription (7-day free trial on the annual plan), and Peppol sends plus optional AI run on one-time credit packs.
